title: Delivery explanation, contract version 1
description: The body of an answer of the delivery API's GET /v1/resolve with debug=1 (PRD 8.9, GUARDRAILS 5), which only an actor whose classification access is at least internal gets: the answer the request would have had, a record with its meta or a problem, with its HTTP status and the explanation of the resolution. It is never stored or shared. Every key is always present, and a value that does not apply is null. The PHP form is Cbox\Cms\Core\Delivery\Domain\Dto\DeliveryExplanation, and the generated codec DeliveryExplanationCodecV1 writes its canonical JSON: keys sorted, no whitespace.

data.description: The record, as data of delivery.v1.json holds it, or null when the answer is a problem.

explanation.description: The explanation of the resolution, a document of path-explanation.v1.json, read as the caller's principal.

meta.description: What the record is, as meta of delivery.v1.json holds it, or null when the answer is a problem.

problem.description: The problem, a document of problem.v1.json, or null when the answer is a record.

status.description: The HTTP status of the answer.

meta.description: What the record is: its type, the locale, the canonical URL and the version of the record contract.

canonical_url.description: The canonical URL of the entry in the locale (PRD 5.7), or null when the reader can read no canonical placement with a URL.

contract.description: The version of the record contract the record is written in (RecordCodecs::VERSION), 1.

locale.description: The locale of the record, a language tag such as da, en-GB or sr-Latn-RS.

type.description: The name of the record's type, <owner>:<handle>, such as app:blog_post; the record is in that type's record contract.
